name: Gores Holdings XI Inc. Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Gores Holdings XI, Inc. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Alec E. Gores on July 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
